Q.
How do I terminate auto-recharge?
Auto-recharge can be terminated anytime via the Edit button. Terminating will only stop the next scheduled recharge, while already purchased credits remain available.
Q.
How do I set up auto-recharge?
You can enable auto-recharge from the
Billing
>
Credit
page by clicking Start auto-recharge.
Recharge amount: Set your preferred amount (bonus included)
Frequency: Choose monthly or yearly
Billing date: Pick your preferred date
Preview (Commitment benefits): Preview bonuses and tier benefits before confirming
Q.
What is the validity period of commitment bonus credits?
Bonus credits are valid only during your Commitment period. Even bonus credits from additional recharges will expire once the Commitment period ends. To maximize your benefits, it’s best to make larger payments at the beginning of your Commitment period.
Q.
What is the commitment tier?
It’s a tiered system that provides benefits based on your purchase amount:
Bonus Credits: Additional credits up to +10% depending on purchase size
Rate Limit
Benefits: Higher requests per second and more pages processed (Tier 1–3)
Automatic Tier Management: Explore, Build, Scale—adjusted automatically by monthly purchase
Eligibility: Applies when monthly purchases are $100 or more
Q.
What is the refund policy?
Important: Purchased credits are generally non-refundable.
Refundable: Only if there is no API usage history
Non-refundable: If the API has been used at least once
* You must agree to the refund policy before purchase
* If you would like a refund, please submit a request through our
Help Center.
Q.
What payment methods are supported?
We currently support credit card payments.
Visa, Mastercard, and other major cards accepted
Card information is securely encrypted
Payment methods can be updated anytime
Other methods: If you need a payment option other than credit card, please contact our
Help center
Q.
How do I purchase credits?
Go to
Billing
>
Credit
in the console
Click "Purchase credits"
Enter your desired amount or choose a preset
Check the box to agree to the refund policy
Click “Confirm and pay” to complete your purchase
Q.
What are credits?
Credits are a prepaid balance system for Upstage AI API services. Even if your credits run out, your API usage won’t be interrupted—charges will be billed to your registered payment method. By pre-purchasing credits, you can also receive various bonus benefits.
Q.
How does Upstage Studio pricing work?
Each agent is billed based on the steps it runs. Parse is the base step included in every agent, billed per page. Extract is billed per page on top of Parse. Classify is currently free (Beta). Instruct is currently free (Beta) — pricing will be announced separately. When multiple steps run together, Parse is only charged once per page.
Q.
How much does a typical Upstage Studio agent cost?
Here are common examples:
Parsing invoices to get structured text → Parse only:
$0.01 / page
Extracting key fields (e.g. vendor, amount, date) from receipts → Parse + Extract:
$0.01 + $0.03 = $0.04 / page
Sorting mixed documents by type, then extracting → Parse + Classify + Extract:
$0.01 + Free + $0.03 = $0.04 / page
